facts.fact: Guinea's regulator ARPT stated in a communique of 30 March 2026 that users may not sell Wi-Fi supplied over Starlink in 'Wi-Fi zones', no licence or prior authorisation having been issued.
ARPT agents were sent into the field to uninstall and confiscate Starlink equipment used by Wi-Fi resellers in Guinea, as reported on 10 August 2026 (date of the seizures not given).
